reviews.conclusion: After nether exit and an eye throw, settings appear at proxy 9 s, game capture becomes enlarged/rearranged and partially obscured at 10.5-12.25 s, then a game-menu sample appears at 12.75 s. Visible menu samples alone do not close the 1.683 s deficit; hidden pause state remains unresolved.
Three brief menu visits span approximately1.0-2.5 s combined, compatible with the1.6333 s deficit. Inventory activity is separate and was not counted as pause time.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
